paper_title: First results from a hidden photon dark matter search in the meV sector using a plane-parabolic mirror system
notes: Dish antenna (plane-parabolic double mirror) search for hidden photon dark matter in the meV range. Upper limit chi ~< 1e-8 for HP mass 0.67-0.92 meV at 90% CL.
